newsitem.title: USA: Resource Mortgage offers preferred shares.
newsitem.headline: Resource Mortgage offers preferred shares.

text.p: Resource Mortgage Capital Inc said on Wednesday it was offering 1.6 million shares of its series C cumulative convertible preferred stock at $30 each.
Stifel, Nicolaus & Co Inc, Robert W. Baird & Co Inc, EVEREN Securities Inc and Scott & Stringfellow Inc are the underwriters of the offering, Resource Mortgage said.
The company granted the underwriters an option to purchase up to 240,000 additional shares of preferred stock to cover over-allotments, if necessary.
The preferred stock will be convertible into common stock at a price of $30 per share.
The quarterly base dividend rate will be $0.73 per share, the company said.
